purpose: Independent caller-visible scalar mutation effects and bounded original local scalar summaries; no purity, total effects, extraction or rewrite-safety permission.

initial_scope.callee: Original same-selected-unit nongeneric free function leaf or one wrapper whose calls all resolve to complete call-free leaves; complete original signature and body; owned u32 inputs, optionally direct &mut u32 formals, u32/unit result; scalar local mutation and primitive expressions plus bounded checked calls only. No deeper calls, closures, aliases, drop-bearing values, unsafe or expansion.
initial_scope.caller: Exact direct call to checked leaf or one wrapper (at most two call edges), exact source/native argument roster; initial arguments limited to checked direct owned-u32 binding/literal reads or direct mutable formal forwarding. Opaque arguments remain unavailable.
initial_scope.metrics: Direct assignment sites remain original caller sites. Summarized call observations count distinct original call occurrences. Callee assignment witnesses remain owned by the callee, and mapped caller-root effect sets deduplicate only exact caller bindings.

evidence_contract.ownership: Validate existing immutable source checksums, exact original function/file ranges, complete signature, native node/child roster, binding targets and selected-unit context before using a summary. Corrupt consumed evidence fails; missing evidence stays unknown.
evidence_contract.callee_join: Native resolved_direct_callee.local=true plus exact definition_identity within the original owning UnitStore/selected-unit context. Paths are navigation only; standalone missing-member lookup is unknown.
evidence_contract.source_and_types: No source-spelling or observed-type authority. Source/native correspondence and normalized types/builtin dispatch establish the bounded vocabulary.
evidence_contract.borrowing: Borrow original functions/native nodes and retain scoped summary indices; reuse each completed immutable leaf summary within the analysis. No graph/source snapshot clone, serialized authority, new SHA or global cache.
evidence_contract.call_arguments: A good leaf summary never erases omitted argument evaluation. Every argument must have exact source/native position/type/root correspondence or explicit unknown availability.
evidence_contract.budgets: Bound owner population, syntax/native inventory, call events and summary retention. Exhausted/omitted owners or events remain unknown; no partial whole-function clean conclusion.

cases.reason: Owned scalar formal rebinding remains local to the leaf; no mutable-reference input, escaping ownership, calls or nontrivial Drop exists in the complete leaf signature/body.

cases.reason: Forwarding a direct mutable formal through one resolved local leaf call exposes a real caller-visible mutation without adding the leaf assignment to the caller direct-site metric.

cases.source: fn set(target:&mut u32) { *target=1; } pub fn caller(target:&mut u32) { set(target); set(target); }
cases.reason: One immutable leaf summary may be reused, but each original call occurrence remains a distinct effect observation; root-level mutation deduplicates only the same exact caller binding.

cases.source: fn set(target:&mut u32) { *target=1; *target=2; *target=3; } pub fn caller(target:&mut u32) { set(target); }
cases.reason: Do not replace direct source-site counts with inlined callee site counts or runtime execution estimates.

cases.source: fn set(value:u32,target:&mut u32) { *target=value; } pub fn caller(target:&mut u32,value:u32) { set(value,target); }
cases.reason: Actual argument position, native root and formal ordinal establish mapping; the same display name in caller/callee grants no mapping authority.

cases.source: fn set(target:&mut u32) { *target=1; } pub fn caller(left:&mut u32,right:&mut u32) { set(left); set(right); }
cases.reason: Root identity remains owner-scoped native declaration plus lexical scope; two formals never collapse because both helper calls use formal zero.

cases.source: mod a { pub fn work(mut value:u32)->u32 { value=1; value } } mod b { pub fn work(target:&mut u32) { *target=1; } } pub fn caller(target:&mut u32) { b::work(target); }
cases.reason: Lookup uses compiler definition identity in exact selected unit, never the final name segment or source spelling.

cases.source: pub fn caller(value:u32) { std::hint::black_box(value); }
cases.reason: The initial summary registry contains original same-unit leaves only; no effect conclusion from library-looking names or scalar signatures.

cases.source: pub fn caller(target:&mut u32,callback:fn(&mut u32)) { callback(target); }
cases.reason: A function pointer has no unique original same-unit definition summary.

cases.source: fn consume(value:String) {} pub fn caller(value:String) { consume(value); }
cases.reason: Unused owned inputs can run Drop. A zero explicit assignment inventory does not establish no caller-visible mutation or general effects.

cases.source: fn set(target:&mut u32) { *target=1; } pub fn caller(target:&mut u32) { let alias=&mut *target; set(alias); }
cases.reason: Do not map aliases using spelling, inferred equality or old root provenance.

cases.source: fn set(target:&mut u32) { *target=1; } pub fn caller<'a>(mut target:&'a mut u32,other:&'a mut u32) { target=other; set(target); }
cases.reason: A reassigned mutable reference cannot retain stale original-formal provenance.

cases.source: fn read(value:u32)->u32 { value } pub fn caller(target:&mut u32,callback:fn()->u32)->u32 { read({ *target=1; callback() }) }
cases.reason: The source/native call argument roster must be checked and arguments evaluated independently. Initial simple-argument support may reject the whole argument but cannot report the call clean.

cases.source: fn read(value:u32,callback:fn()->u32)->u32 { value } pub fn caller(value:u32,callback:fn()->u32)->u32 { read(value,callback) }
cases.reason: Initial complete leaf signatures allow owned u32, direct mutable u32 formal and scalar/unit results only; do not ignore unsupported unused formals.

cases.source: pub fn deferred(target:&mut u32) { let _callback=|| { *target=1; }; } pub fn raw(target:*mut u32) { unsafe { *target=1; } }
cases.reason: Deferred bodies, captures and raw-pointer effects require separate contracts; source resemblance does not qualify a scalar leaf.

cases.source: fn recurse(value:u32)->u32 { recurse(value) } pub fn caller(value:u32)->u32 { recurse(value) }
cases.reason: Initial leaf summaries exclude every callee call, including recursion; no assumed empty fixed point or panic/termination claim.

cases.source: fn leaf(value:u32)->u32 { value+1 } fn middle(value:u32)->u32 { leaf(value) } pub fn caller(value:u32)->u32 { middle(value) }
cases.reason: C11d explicitly extends the prior depth-one negative to a complete two-edge owned-scalar chain. Empty complete leaf and wrapper summaries prove only absence of bounded caller-visible writes; arbitrary transitive closure remains excluded.

cases.source: fn leaf(value:u32)->u32 { value+1 } fn middle(value:u32)->u32 { leaf(value) } fn outer(value:u32)->u32 { middle(value) } pub fn caller(value:u32)->u32 { outer(value) }
cases.reason: A third original helper edge exceeds the declared two-edge contract, even when the body is pure-looking owned-scalar arithmetic. No empty summary or arbitrary closure is assumed.

cases.source: fn set(target:&mut u32) { *target=1; } pub fn caller(target:&mut u32,callback:fn()) { set(target); callback(); }
cases.reason: A concrete known mutation witness survives unknown remainder, but does not establish a complete set of effects or roots.

cases.source: fn leaf(value:u32)->u32 { value+1 } pub fn caller(value:u32)->u32 { leaf(value) }
cases.reason: A resolved definition ID with no retained original same-unit callee source cannot supply a summary.

cases.source: fn leaf(value:u32)->u32 { value+1 } pub fn caller(value:u32)->u32 { leaf(value) }
cases.reason: Missing evidence is unavailable; a contradictory consumed roster/span/target is corruption and fails instead.

cases.source: #[allow(non_camel_case_types)] pub struct u32(core::primitive::u32); impl core::ops::Deref for u32 { type Target=core::primitive::u32; fn deref(&self)->&Self::Target { &self.0 } } impl core::ops::DerefMut for u32 { fn deref_mut(&mut self)->&mut Self::Target { &mut self.0 } } fn set(target:&mut core::primitive::u32) { *target=1; } pub fn caller(target:&mut u32) { set(target); }
cases.reason: A nominal namesake and DerefMut coercion do not establish a direct primitive mutable formal. Structural compiler observations distinguish the caller from the builtin callee.

cases.source: fn read(target:&u32) {} pub fn caller(target:&u32) { read(target); }
cases.reason: A shared primitive reference has no mutable formal authority and remains outside the initial complete leaf signature vocabulary.
